faq.q: How do I install Geometry Dash on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Geometry Dash and check the developer is RobTop Games before tapping the price button. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It costs $3.99 on Google Play, and once bought it's tied to your Google account, so you can reinstall it on any phone for free. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from RobTop Games and may be altered, so the safest way to play Geometry Dash is the official listing.

faq.q: How much is Geometry Dash on Android?
faq.a: Geometry Dash costs $3.99 on Google Play in the US, as a one-time purchase with no ads. The free Geometry Dash Lite has fewer levels and no level editor.
Geometry Dash is rated Everyone 10+ for fantasy violence and mild blood. Online levels and comments are made by other players, so younger children may need supervision.

faq.q: What's the difference between Geometry Dash and Geometry Dash Lite?
faq.a: Lite is the free demo with a handful of levels and ads. The full game adds every official level, the level editor, online levels made by players, and no ads.
